description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called `MenuHostedItem` which embeds SwiftUI content into an AppKit NSMenuItem view via NSViewRepresentable.

classes.name: MenuHostedItem
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that hosts arbitrary SwiftUI content as an AppKit view for embedding in a native NSMenuItem.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and returns an NSHostingView initialized with the root SwiftUI view and applies sizing.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing NSHostingView with the current rootView and re-applies sizing.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the hosting view based on the specified width and the fitting size of the content.
